title: Count non-blank lines, closing the Reader with try-with-resources
contract: Counts lines that are not empty or whitespace-only, accepting \n, \r\n and \r separators. Always closes the reader before returning, including when reading throws, and the IOException propagates. A null reader returns 0.
notShownInJavadoc: close called exactly once on success
close called on failure while the IOException still propagates
